name: Buffer Overflow (Out-of-Bounds Write)
essence: An unchecked length writes past the buffer into adjacent, shared memory.

examples.summary: ctypes copies an unchecked name length past its fixed array field into the adjacent shared status field..
examples.mechanism: ctypes copies an unchecked name length past its fixed array field into the adjacent shared status field.
examples.expected_behavior: Preserve status OPEN while bounding the stored name.

ingredients.suggests: A raw address into the shared customer record is handed to a memory copy.
The input copy length exceeds the fixed name field and overwrites adjacent status bytes.

examples.summary: An unchecked name copy crosses the name array and overwrites adjacent shared status bytes.
examples.mechanism: unsafe pointer arithmetic bypasses array bounds and writes beyond the name subobject into adjacent fields of one process-owned Parcel allocation.

ingredients.suggests: The name field is written through an unchecked raw pointer.
The copy follows input length rather than the name array capacity.

examples.summary: The oversized name overwrites the adjacent units field.
examples.mechanism: unsafe pointer copying bypasses array bounds; repr(C) keeps the adjacent witness inside the same owned allocation. A raw name pointer allows a copy to cross the field boundary into the adjacent units. The copy uses the full input length without checking the fixed name capacity.

ingredients.suggests: A raw name pointer allows a copy to cross the field boundary into the adjacent units.
The copy uses the full input length without checking the fixed name capacity.
